mapper.insert: INSERT IGNORE INTO admin_users (login_id, password_hash, role) VALUES (#{loginId}, #{passwordHash}, #{role})
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM admin_users WHERE login_id = #{loginId} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM admin_users WHERE admin_id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_logs (admin_id, action_type, target_type, target_id, action_detail) VALUES (#{adminId}, #{actionType}, #{targetType}, #{targetId}, #{actionDetail})
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND created_at >= CURRENT_DATE()
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM users WHERE deleted_at IS NULL AND last_login_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM api_usage_logs WHERE created_at >= CURRENT_DATE()
SELECT user_id AS id, nickname, email, provider, created_at AS createdAt, last_login_at AS lastLoginAt FROM users WHERE deleted_at IS NULL ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO api_usage_logs (user_id, api_type, success, duration_ms, error_code) VALUES (#{userId}, #{apiType}, #{success}, #{durationMs}, #{errorCode})
mapper.select: SELECT TIMESTAMP(DATE(created_at), MAKETIME(HOUR(created_at), 0, 0)) AS hour, api_type AS apiType, COUNT(*) AS callCount, SUM(success = TRUE) AS successCount FROM api_usage_logs WHERE created_at >= DATE_SUB(NOW(), INTERVAL #{hours} HOUR) GROUP BY TIMESTAMP(DATE(created_at), MAKETIME(HOUR(created_at), 0, 0)), api_type ORDER BY hour
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO batch_job_history (job_name, trigger_type, status, started_at) VALUES (#{jobName}, #{triggerType}, #{status}, #{startedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT batch_history_id AS id, job_name AS jobName, trigger_type AS triggerType, status, processed_count AS processedCount, duration_ms AS durationMs, started_at AS startedAt, finished_at AS finishedAt, error_message AS errorMessage FROM batch_job_history ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT batch_history_id AS id, job_name AS jobName, trigger_type AS triggerType, status, processed_count AS processedCount, duration_ms AS durationMs, started_at AS startedAt, finished_at AS finishedAt, error_message AS errorMessage FROM batch_job_history ORDER BY started_at DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_push_history (admin_id, title, content, target_condition, sent_count) VALUES (#{adminId}, #{title}, #{content}, JSON_OBJECT('target', 'ALL_NON_WITHDRAWN_USERS'), #{sentCount})
INSERT INTO notifications (user_id, notification_type, title, content, sent_at) SELECT user_id, 'ADMIN_PUSH', #{title}, #{content}, NOW() FROM users WHERE deleted_at IS NULL
mapper.select: SELECT h.push_history_id AS id, a.login_id AS adminLoginId, h.title, h.content, h.sent_count AS sentCount, h.created_at AS createdAt FROM admin_push_history h JOIN admin_users a ON a.admin_id = h.admin_id ORDER BY h.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT l.admin_log_id AS id, a.login_id AS adminLoginId, l.action_type AS actionType, l.target_type AS targetType, l.target_id AS targetId, l.action_detail AS actionDetail, h.title AS noticeTitle, h.content AS noticeContent, l.created_at AS createdAt FROM admin_logs l JOIN admin_users a ON a.admin_id = l.admin_id LEFT JOIN admin_push_history h ON l.action_type = 'SEND_NOTICE' AND h.push_history_id = CAST(l.target_id AS UNSIGNED) ORDER BY l.created_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
